resources.string: Choose an address your AI can reach, then copy the prompt below and send it to your AI.
Read this link, install the Phone Use Skill and connect to my phone. Show me the pairing code and wait for my confirmation before continuing.\n\n%1$s
Allow paired external clients to read the screen and UI elements, and perform taps, text input, and navigation. Keep the phone awake and unlocked. You can revoke client access in the app at any time.
The device ID stays with this installation. IP address changes do not affect pairing.
Keep the phone awake and unlocked during use. You can revoke client access in the app at any time.
Background pop-up windows are not allowed.
Permission status is unavailable on this system. You can check it in system settings.

To open other apps while Phone Use is in the background, allow background pop-up windows in Other permissions. Permission names vary by system version. Also check for an app-opening confirmation or another dialog on the phone, even when this permission is allowed.
Check the phone for an app-opening confirmation. In system settings, check whether Phone Use is allowed to open apps from the background.
Last launch was not confirmed: %1$s. The app may be slow to open, blocked by a dialog, or restricted by the system. Check the screen before trying again.
App launch not confirmed · Open Phone Use for help
Could not confirm opening %1$s. Tap to check permissions, app-opening dialogs, or loading delays.
Service available · Last app launch not confirmed
Could not open settings. Open Phone Use’s app details in system settings to check its permissions.

Connect with MCP or the Python client on the same network. Compare all eight digits before approving here. The local web console uses HTTP and follows the access address allowlist. Remote HTTPS browsers require certificate trust.
Pair each client once. The service starts automatically when the app opens, and paired clients are preserved.
Compare every digit with the code shown by your client. Approve only if they match. Never let remote tools approve for you. You can revoke access at any time.
Pairing request received · Open app to approve
Device name must contain 1–80 printable characters.
Could not save the device name. Please try again.
Could not save client approval. Please try again.
1–80 characters. Only changes the name in Phone Use.

In system accessibility settings, find Phone Use under Downloaded apps or Installed services, then turn on the service and confirm. If it stops working after leaving the app, check Settings → Background keep-alive in Phone Use.
Connect to Wi-Fi to show a network address. The local console is still available.
Could not unpair this client. Please try again.
Choose the language for the app and its notifications.
Enables HTTP; the access address allowlist and pairing still apply. HTTP is not encrypted: screen content, actions, and credentials may be intercepted. Keep this off unless needed.
One IP address or domain per line, without a scheme, port, path, or wildcard.
Check each line: enter one valid IP address or domain without a scheme, port, path, or wildcard.

Leave blank to allow the phone’s own IP addresses; otherwise, only listed access addresses are accepted. Adding an address does not enable HTTP: HTTPS is required by default, except for local access through 127.0.0.1. Include 127.0.0.1 to use the local console.
Only addresses in the allowlist are accepted. Network routing and port forwarding must be configured separately.
The local web console is blocked by the allowlist. Add 127.0.0.1 in Settings or clear the list to restore default IP access.

Follow the keep-alive settings to allow background activity and autostart, and remove battery restrictions. Otherwise, connections may stall and operations may slow down or time out even when the network is working.

Before use, turn on background keep-alive and follow the settings guidance to remove system background restrictions. These restrictions can cause stalled connections, slow operations, or timeouts. Removing Phone Use from recent apps stops the control service.

Turn on background keep-alive, allow background activity and autostart in system settings, and remove battery restrictions. Background restrictions can delay secure connections and cause slow operations or timeouts even when the network is working. This switch alone does not remove system restrictions.
Keep the control service running with a persistent notification. Try to restore it after system reclamation, reboot, an app update, or accessibility reconnection. May increase battery use.

Automatic recovery is off. Removing Phone Use from recent apps stops the control service. Switching to another app keeps the current session running. Accessibility permission and system battery settings stay unchanged.
System battery optimization: active; connections may stall and operations may slow down or time out
In HyperOS / MIUI, allow Phone Use to autostart, set battery saver to No restrictions, and lock it in recent apps. Autostart must be checked manually; unavailable shortcuts open app details.

In App launch, manage Phone Use manually and allow auto-launch, secondary launch, and background activity. Lock it in recent apps. Check these settings manually; unavailable shortcuts open app details.
Allow Phone Use to autostart and run in the background, remove battery restrictions, and lock it in recent apps. Check these settings manually; unavailable shortcuts open app details.
In Battery → Background usage limits, add Phone Use to Never sleeping apps. The button opens app details; also allow background battery use there. Check these settings manually.
In system app settings, allow background battery use and autostart if available. If your system supports it, lock Phone Use in recent apps. These options vary by device and must be checked manually.
The service notification is disabled. Allow it to see background status and return to Phone Use easily.

System permissions need your confirmation. Force-stop and some vendor restrictions can still stop the app. Reopen Phone Use after a force-stop; if accessibility was turned off, enable it again in system settings.
Could not open settings. Open Phone Use’s app details in system settings to allow background activity and autostart.
